item.title: Cambridge Avenue – from the junction with Kilburn High Road to the zebra crossing opposite Kilburn Park Station, 27th September
item.description:
This is not an isolated pothole or a small area of road damage. The carriageway along this section of Cambridge Avenue is extensively deteriorated at multiple locations. Cambridge Avenue is a heavily used route, including regular use by several bus services, and the road surface has progressively deteriorated along the section from Kilburn High Road to the zebra crossing opposite Kilburn Park Station. I am aware that individual defects may already have been reported and there are markings on the carriageway which appear to indicate planned localised repairs. However, the issue being reported here is the overall condition of this entire section, rather than individual potholes or patches. Repeated localised patch repairs are unlikely to provide a durable solution. I therefore request that Brent Council carry out a comprehensive engineering inspection of this section and assess it for any necessary underlying repairs followed by full-width resurfacing of the carriageway and reinstatement of the road markings. If there is already an existing case for localised repairs, please do not close this report simply as a duplicate. Please refer it to the Highways Maintenance/Engineering team to consider whether the whole section should be included in the Council’s carriageway resurfacing programme. Photographs from several locations along the section are attached to demonstrate the extent of the deterioration.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Cambridge Avenue, London
Report on FixMyStreet
